name: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Foundational course covering algorithms, data structures, and programming basics.
syllabus: Week 1-2: Introduction to Programming & Python Basics
Week 5-6: Data Structures — Lists, Stacks, Queues
Week 11-12: File I/O and Exception Handling

assignments.title: Assignment 1: Python Basics
assignments.description: Write programs demonstrating variables, loops, and functions.

assignments.title: Assignment 2: Data Structures
assignments.description: Implement a stack and queue using linked lists.

assignments.title: Final Project: Mini Application
assignments.description: Build a small command-line application using concepts from the entire course.

name: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence
description: Survey course on AI paradigms, search, knowledge representation, and machine learning fundamentals.
syllabus: Week 1-2: What is AI? History and Foundations
Week 3-4: Intelligent Agents and Rational Behavior
Week 5-6: Search Algorithms — BFS, DFS, A*
Week 9-10: Machine Learning Basics — Supervised Learning
Week 11-12: Neural Networks and Deep Learning Introduction
Week 13-14: Natural Language Processing and RAG
Week 15-16: Ethics in AI and Course Review

assignments.title: Assignment 1: Search Algorithms
assignments.description: Implement BFS and A* on a grid-world problem.

assignments.title: Assignment 2: ML Classification
assignments.description: Train and evaluate a classifier on the Iris dataset.

assignments.title: Final Project: AI Application
assignments.description: Design an AI agent for a classroom task and present findings.

name: Linear Algebra for Computing
description: Vectors, matrices, transformations, eigenvalues, and applications in data science.
syllabus: Week 15-16: Applications in ML and Review

assignments.title: Problem Set 1: Systems & Vectors
assignments.description: Solve systems of equations and perform vector operations.

assignments.title: Problem Set 2: Eigenvalue Analysis
assignments.description: Compute eigenvalues and eigenvectors for given matrices.
